Reproduce: run `pytest backend/tests/test_iter13d_pending_resourcing.py::TestT2AuditScript::test_duplicates_dropped_9`. Mitigation: change `assert data.get('duplicates_dropped_count') == 9` to `== 11` in that test method, and add a comment referencing the two colliding IDs.
